prompt:
Create a faithful generated game asset for G-Embryo, exact incarnation Resident Evil Outbreak (2003). Use the attached verified references only. Preserve the precise head, anatomy, proportions, costume, equipment, material colours and asymmetric details. Do not mix games, phases or editions. Match the source appearance without added cartoon outlines, coloured halos or decoration. One subject only, no text, labels, scenery, floor, montage or frame. Clean transparent alpha. This remains a generated adaptation, not an original Capcom frame or a geometric 1:1 certificate. One complete full-body static combat idle base pose, facing right in a side/three-quarter fighting-game view. Keep every source-documented limb, foot, tail, wing, tentacle, horn and equipment inside the image with generous transparent padding. Preserve actual locomotion and support points; do not turn a quadruped or aquatic creature into a humanoid. Produce the entire body in this one image, not separate pieces. No motion blur, duplicate bodies or animation-frame grid. Only proceed after actually reviewing a complete source body reference.
Preserve the complete small larva: smooth blind rounded head with toothy open mouth, tapering tail and two small splayed forelimbs with flat ends. Head/mouth point RIGHT and tail LEFT in a low poised larval stance. Do not make a human or add hind legs.
Composition: at least ten percent clear transparent padding around every body, wing, foot, tail and equipment endpoint. One complete boss entry in ONE image, clear rightward presentation; no animation grid, scenery, labels or added coloured halo. Preserve real anatomical asymmetries; no software mirror.
sourceObservation: Entire larva visible with smooth blind head, toothy open mouth, tapering tail and two splayed small forelimbs ending in flat supports. All visible anatomical endpoints are inside frame.
